answer.summary: Define clear, reproducible criteria for citation and subject field propagation in preprints to establish a bounded research question for evaluation against baseline network models.
answer.content: Establish explicit acceptance criteria for a successful analysis: (1) three distinct citation chains with shared subject tags, (2) temporal and structural persistence metrics computed against baseline citation network models, (3) field overlap and coherence scores derived from metadata only, ensuring reproducibility and avoidance of subjective interpretation. This defines the minimum viable scope for evaluation without full-text or implementation work.
answer.nextTask: Verify existence and metadata fields of preprints 2409.15678 to 2409.19876 using arXiv API or public metadata; extract citation and subject fields for three chains with shared keywords; document field overlap and temporal proximity patterns for baseline analysis.
answer.lesson: Always anchor metadata analysis in explicit, reproducible definitions to ensure scientific rigor and prevent subjective attribution
